user.title: Connect to Hunter NODE-BT
user.description: Select your Hunter NODE-BT controller or enter its Bluetooth address.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the controller over Bluetooth. Ensure it is powered and within range.
error.invalid_auth: The PIN provided was rejected by the controller.

abort.already_configured: This Hunter NODE-BT controller is already configured.

start_watering.name: Start watering
start_watering.description: Water a station for a specific duration.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to water (up to 4 hours).

set_program.name: Set program
set_program.description: Change a program's start times, water days or a station's run time. Anything left out stays as it is.

config_entry_id.name: Controller
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one controller is set up.

start_times.name: Start times
start_times.description: 24-hour start times such as 06:30. An empty list turns the program's starts off.

water_days.name: Water days
water_days.description: 'every day', 'odd days', 'even days', 'every 3 days' or day names such as 'Mon, Wed, Fri'.

station.name: Station
station.description: Station whose run time to change.

run_minutes.name: Run time
run_minutes.description: Minutes the station waters on each start (0 removes it from the program).
